title: A5 append-only resumable work-unit ledger record
description: Every record is an append. In-place edit is detected by recomputing sha256 over (prev_sha256 + canonical payload). Delivery is at-least-once plus idempotent units; the exclusive-execution mechanism is the CLAIM record's (dedupe_key, fencing_token, lease_until_ns) triple under fcntl.LOCK_EX compare-and-append, not an asserted exactly-once property.

idempotence_key.description: Stable key for at-least-once replay. Same key must not produce a second side-effecting execution after SUCCEEDED.

claim_id.description: Opaque id of one CLAIM attempt. Named exclusive-execution mechanism together with fencing_token and lease_until_ns.

fencing_token.description: Monotonic per dedupe_key. A COMPLETE/FAIL whose fencing_token does not match the active CLAIM is ignored.

lease_until_ns.description: CLAIM is active until this monotonic-ish epoch ns. Expiry returns the unit to QUEUED.

dedupe_key.description: Exactly one live CLAIM per dedupe_key. Default equals unit_id. Named in this schema; not a prose guarantee.
